senses.gloss: to soil, defile, make unclean, unfit for sacrifice.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 34:5">Targ. Gen. XXXIV, 5</cite>; a. fr.—

Taan. 11ᵃ bot. ההוא דסָאֵיב נפשיה that is because he defiled himself (by touching a corpse &c.). Y. Maas. Sh. III, 54ᵇ top מְסָאֵב לה ופדי לה made the fruit unclean and also redeemed it. Y. Snh.
